rows.jyutping: m4 do1 tung4 jan4 loi4 wong5
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for someone who keeps to themselves and prefers little social contact.

example.english: They are reclusive and would rather stay home reading on their days off.
example.traditional: 佢唔多同人來往，放假寧願留喺屋企睇書。
example.jyutping: keoi5 m4 do1 tung4 jan4 loi4 wong5 fong3 gaa3 ning4 jyun6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 tai2 syu1

rows.note: Use this when the person’s reclusiveness is presented as an unsociable or withdrawn personality trait.

example.english: They are reclusive and do not even greet the neighbours when they see them.
example.traditional: 佢個人好孤僻，見到鄰居都唔會打招呼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gu1 pik1 gin3 dou2 leon4 geoi1 dou1 m4 wui5 daa2 ziu1 fu1

rows.note: Use this for someone who stays secluded at home and rarely goes out, especially in writing.

example.english: The writer has been reclusive for years and hardly accepts interviews.
example.traditional: 嗰位作家多年來深居簡出，幾乎唔接受訪問。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 zok3 gaa1 do1 nin4 loi4 sam1 geoi1 gaan2 ceot1 gei1 fu4 m4 zip3 sau6 fong2 man6
